cv.name: Tomasz Hrabowski
cv.headline: Civil Engineer | Drainage and highways design | ICE Graduate Member
cv.summary: Civil engineer with around five years of experience in highways and drainage design for local authorities and developers. I took a two-year career break to care for a parent in Poland and returned in 2023; I am working towards Chartered status with the ICE.

experience.title: Civil Engineer
bullets: Drainage design and SuDS strategies for residential schemes of 50 to 400 homes
Section 278 and Section 38 highway design and technical approval submissions
Prepare flood risk assessments and drainage reports for planning applications
Model networks in MicroDrainage and Civil 3D

experience.title: Graduate Civil Engineer
bullets: Supported design of junction improvements for two London boroughs
Site supervision support on a bus priority scheme

experience.title: Placement Year Student
bullets: Produced drawings and quantities for footway and resurfacing works

education.degree: MEng Civil Engineering (with Year in Industry)

extra_sections: Career break (2021 – 2023): caring for a family member in Poland; completed an online InfoDrainage course in 2022
